label: release checks the hold's status before advancing the clock, so a hold that runs out during that advance is released a second time
putAway checks for a new bin after writing it, so the cached pick path is never invalidated and later picks can't see new bins
start checks on-hand instead of available, so transfers can ship stock held for orders
Replenishment removed (phase 2 feature)
expire scans every reservation ever placed on every call (phase 3 bottleneck)
